cords.name: p10s1
cords.notes: A fragment stored with the quipu was associated with 10s1.  The subsidiary is broken at 9.0 cm and the fragment is 5.0 cm long, broken at both ends, and has a cluster of 7s knots.

cords.name: p116s1
